title: OL Agent - Stand Alone Evaluations
subtitle: Standalone deep-dive analyses of individual SEVAL HeroEval runs

analyses.label: CodeGen failure triage — EmailTriage Primitives (run 576292)
analyses.highlights: 632 of 932 CodeGen assertions failed (32% pass) across 203 queries; 470 are regressions where Mainline passed the same check. Top trends: tool-not-invoked (202), CreateRule target-folder-missing (91), missing disambiguation list (55), missing citation (49), write-did-not-persist (49), mock tool response (49), capability refusal (49). Interactive report filters by trend/tool and exports an ADO selection JSON.

analyses.label: CodeGen vs CodeGen+OMNI — head-to-head
analyses.highlights: CodeGen+OMNI nets +2.0pp (73.8% vs 71.8%) over 347 comparable assertions. OMNI wins 47 (saves drafts to the Drafts folder, disambiguates); CodeGen wins 40 — but 32 of those are empty / uncaptured OMNI replies on heavy compound tasks (Calendar OOO, Rules), not quality losses. 51 both-fail (folder-delete unsupported, compound multi-step).

analyses.label: HeroV28 Mainline vs CodeGen — both-arm assertion triage
analyses.highlights: 78 of 466 assertions failed in BOTH control and experiment across 37 queries. Root causes: 69% model/agent behavior (HITL confirmation gaps + capability refusals), 23% missing data (empty mailbox), 8% bad assertions (false negatives).

analyses.label: Outlook agent — HeroPrompt V27 single-run report
analyses.highlights: Single-run evaluation of the Outlook agent (gpt-55-reasoning) over the 65-query HeroPrompt V27 hero set: 28 of 65 queries fully passed (43.1%) and 255 of 325 assertions passed (78.5%). By level: critical 75.2% (191/254), expected 89.8% (53/59), aspirational 91.7% (11/12). Execution dimensions are near-ceiling (tool call / code generated / answer generated 100%, execution success 98.5%); the remaining gap is answer-correctness (43.1%). Run cost $32.36 over 18.3M tokens, ~47s average latency. Report merges a filterable per-query list with judge rationales, generated code, and execution traces.
